swap_risks: HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 31% (TPS54302DDCR: 400 kHz p.5 vs TPS563201DDCR: 580 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS54302DDCR: 10 µH p.18 vs TPS563201DDCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (TPS54302DDCR: 0.596 V p.5 vs TPS563201DDCR: 0.768 V p.6); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (TPS54302DDCR: 28 V p.4 vs TPS563201DDCR: 17 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS563201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to switching frequency differs >30%; recommended inductor value differs >20%; feedback reference voltage Vref differs. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 400 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.6), rated current is 3000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 10 µH (p.18) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), and Iq is 45 µA (p.5) vs 120 µA (p.6). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 118.9 vs 92.6 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
